user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking by its ID so that I can see its details.

positive.title: Retrieve booking with valid ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
positive.expected_result: Booking details are displayed for the given ID

negative.title: Retrieve booking with non-existent ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the booking ID does not exist

negative.title: Retrieve booking with invalid ID format
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
Enter an invalid format booking ID (e.g. '123abc!')
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the booking ID format is invalid

edge.title: Retrieve booking with very large ID number
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
Enter a very large number as booking ID
edge.expected_result: Either the booking details are displayed or an error message is shown without crashing

edge.title: Retrieve booking with an empty ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page
Leave the booking ID field empty
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking ID field cannot be empty
